representativeTask.title: OpenClaw agent: implement and verify a code edit
representativeTask.description: The pinned OpenClaw runtime (openclaw/openclaw, revision f6883b3771c0a40d7bd62fcb99815dcbbb2e24f3, "OpenClaw 2026.9.7 (f6883b3)") solves a real coding task headless — implementing a documented function through its file and terminal tools, running the verification itself — with Zeck as its sole AI execution authority: every model turn rides the delegated agent-loop seam through the multi-surface delegation boundary, and the same boundary carries the vision, speech-recognition, speech-generation and image-generation surfaces the corpus proves.

reproducibility.instructions:
Prepare the pinned checkout: git clone https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw.git && git -C openclaw checkout f6883b3771c0a40d7bd62fcb99815dcbbb2e24f3 at /home/z/openclaw-upstream, then pnpm install --ignore-scripts (pnpm@12.5.1). Build the compiled runtime: bun run compat/openclaw/harness/build-compiled-runtime.ts (transforms every .ts under src/ and packages/

/src/ to in-place .js siblings with the checkout's own esbuild, generates per-package src/package.json exports from the app's own tsconfig paths, repoints the @openclaw workspace links at the packages' src/, and links dist to src; writes compiled-runtime.manifest.json; the builder's verify mode proves byte-identity). Then run the battery: bun run compat/openclaw/harness/run-battery.ts (resumable; every step checkpoints to /tmp/ppr-023-battery/battery-state.json). The battery requires the sandbox's authorized GLM supply config (/etc/.z-ai-config) — platform-side BYOK material, never present in the OpenClaw runtime — and the sandbox's Playwright Chromium for the browser task (browser.executablePath, the app's own config axis).
